import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function to perform matrix multiplication
def matrix_multiply(A, B, m, n, k):
    # Convert input matrices to 1D float arrays
    A_flat = np.array(A, dtype=np.float32).flatten()
    B_flat = np.array(B, dtype=np.float32).flatten()
    C_flat = np.zeros((m * n), dtype=np.float32)

    # Define the cblas_sgemm function
    cblas_sgemm = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so').cblas_sgemm
    cblas_sgemm.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int,
                            ctypes.c_float, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int,
                            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_float,
                            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int]

    # Call the cblas_sgemm function
    cblas_sgemm(101, 111, 111, m, n, k, 1.0,
                A_flat.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), k,
                B_flat.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), n,
                0.0, C_flat.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), n)

    # Convert the result back to a 2D list
    C = C_flat.reshape((m, n)).tolist()
    return C

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    A = [[1.0, 2.0],
         [3.0, 4.0]]
    B = [[5.0, 6.0],
         [7.0, 8.0]]
    expected_C = [[19.0, 22.0],
                  [43.0, 50.0]]
    result_C = matrix_multiply(A, B, 2, 2, 2)
    assert np.allclose(result_C, expected_C, atol=1e-2), f"Test failed: {result_C} != {expected_C}"

    A = [[0.11, 0.12, 0.13],
         [0.21, 0.22, 0.23]]
    B = [[1011, 1012],
         [1021, 1022],
         [1031, 1032]]
    expected_C = [[367.76, 368.12],
                  [674.06, 674.72]]
    result_C = matrix_multiply(A, B, 2, 2, 3)
    assert np.allclose(result_C, expected_C, atol=1e-2), f"Test failed: {result_C} != {expected_C}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
